blockers.reason: Primary alternate views and the official pinch diagram establish this exposed shape. The native authored outer section is a single chamfered envelope, consistent with the silhouette and retained app frame; this mismatch is not an interior painter-order artifact.
blockers.minimumCorrection: Author the exposed outer-wing recess and distinct lower projecting lip from whole primary evidence, preserving mirrored units and existing twenty contact identities/facts. Keep unspecified radii and transition dimensions labeled estimates. This is a shape correction, not permission to add pinch contacts or unseen geometry.

physicalObservations.symmetry: Mirrored ten-contact sets and paired visible features retained. Broad slopers, diagonal rails, two stacked MR pockets, stepped closed crimp and shared IM cavity occupy source-supported relative locations.
physicalObservations.closedCrimp: Stepped opening and thumb-side return are present, with source-supported 7.5 mm depth in source-bound native report. Rounded drafting is simplified; no separate demonstrated blocker beyond outer wing.
physicalObservations.largeFlatEdge: Upper inner-wing edge location matches the hold chart. Its front projection collapses to a line because the ledge faces upward; this alone is not a missing contact. Its 8 mm modeled extent is an estimate, not a published hold depth.
physicalObservations.contacts: Retained native report supports actual body surfaces and separate IM shallow/deep ownership; the two app selections visually correspond to left outer sloper and right inner half of the bottom cavity. Current runtime tapping of every contact was not exercised.
physicalObservations.rendererLimit: CPU flat normals/mean-depth painter can misorder interior faces; triangulated shading and dark patches are not geometry findings. The wing blocker uses actual outer silhouette, authored section and historical exact-asset app view, independently of prior geometry.
